items.name: The $.$. Rocky
items.description: A$AP Rocky's battleship moored on the shore — home of the season's first boss, with mounted cannons and a Choppa on board.
items.rationale: Boss drop plus a Choppa make it the strongest loot and fastest exit on the map, but it will be the hottest drop of launch week — risky in tournaments. A metal ship deck won't give many materials.

items.name: Loguetown
items.description: A dense town on the northern shore of the southern bay, with roads running out in several directions.
items.rationale: Dense buildings mean lots to loot and farm, and the central position with roads out makes rotating easy. Early guides tip it for fights, so expect company.

items.name: Lantern Landing
items.description: A lantern-lit maze of streets just north of the unexplained purple ring, close to the middle of the island.
items.rationale: Near the middle with roads out, so rotations are short; tight streets give cover and materials for close fights. Tipped for early action alongside Loguetown.

items.name: Arlong Park
items.description: One Piece's fish-man stronghold: a walled compound with a tiered tower, linked to the mainland by a single bridge.
items.rationale: A big walled compound should be loot-heavy, but the only way off the island is one bridge — easy to get trapped when the zone pulls inland. Better for casual squads than tournaments.

items.name: Rubber Resort
items.description: A resort on its own island with a duck-shaped yacht, joined by a bridge toward the northern desert.
items.rationale: The quietest start on the map — isolated in a corner — which suits a safe ranked or tournament drop. The trade-off is a long rotation over a single bridge.

items.name: The Chest
items.description: A cluster of islets west of the northern desert. Epic hasn't described it yet — the name hints at loot.

items.name: Loot Lagoon
items.description: Where the river meets the northern coast.

items.name: Lil' Uzi's Stronghold
items.description: Lil Uzi Vert's fort at the edge of the desert, beside a large green island. It changes on 7 November.

items.name: Cursed Cavern
items.description: A dark crater in the green zone, centre-east.

items.name: Windmill Village
items.description: Luffy's home town from One Piece, on an island linked to the mainland.

items.name: Plunder Port
items.description: Docks on the south coast with two ships moored offshore.

items.name: Busy Bay
items.description: Two connected islands in the south-east corner.
